relationships.subject: juvenile idiopathic arthritis
relationships.evidence_quote: the S100B concentrations measured by commercial ELISA, were significantly higher in JIA patients compared to controls

relationships.subject: S100B
relationships.evidence_quote: In vitro studies have suggested that excessive production of S100B by astrocytes might lead to the production of pro-inflammatory mediators such as TNF-α and IL-1β by microglia

key_findings: Plasma astrocyte-derived EVs and S100B were higher in children with JIA than controls and higher with JADAS27 of 1 or more
Authors interpret findings as evidence of BBB disruption and CNS involvement in JIA
